description: A venue operations director must approve the operating plan for a festival screening in a temporary cinema, including the auditorium, audience capacity, recording policy, and crowd-flow controls.

shared_context.S1: The festival plans to present one feature screening in a temporary cinema with an audience and a recorded post-screening Q&A.
shared_context.S2: The draft run sheet places the screening in Hall A, allows 180 audience members, permits recording of the Q&A for the festival archive, and uses ordinary two-way audience movement.
shared_context.S3: Morgan gives the final approval for the venue operating plan.
shared_context.S4: Before the daily run sheet is approved, the venue holds a routine technical and safety huddle in which the projection supervisor and safety and insurance coordinator review the plan with Morgan.

PF1.text: The distributor's current KDM is authorized only for Hall B's secure projector and includes a no-camera-capture condition for the screening and Q&A; Leila confirmed this in the distributor portal this morning, but the portal update arrived after the technical run sheet was circulated.

PF2.text: The signed fire-marshal certificate caps Hall B at exactly 140 audience members because one exit is under repair, and the insurer requires a filed crowd-flow plan specifying one-way entry before admission; Owen received the certificate after the morning operations meeting and has not yet attached it to the venue file.

acceptance_conditions: The screening must move to Hall B because the distributor authorization is valid only there.
The audience capacity must be exactly 140.
The screening and Q&A recording must not be permitted.
Audience movement must use one-way entry.
A crowd-flow plan specifying one-way entry and the 140-person cap must be filed before admission.

content_checks.C5: any(('file' in c.get('detail', '') or 'filing' in c.get('detail', '') or 'prepare' in c.get('detail', '')) and 'one-way entry' in c.get('detail', '') and ('insurer' in c.get('detail', '') or c.get('target', '') == 'insurer' or c.get('target', '') == 'Owen') and ('before admission' in c.get('detail', '') or 'before opening doors' in c.get('detail', '') or 'before doors open' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The KDM changes the auditorium from Hall A to Hall B and changes recording_permitted from True to False because the authorization is limited to Hall B and forbids camera capture.

The signed certificate changes the audience capacity from the draft 180 to exactly 140, changes the flow to one-way entry, and requires a commitment to file the one-way entry crowd-flow plan with the insurer before admission.
